facts.fact: Ittan's name stood first on the council letter that proposed the match; Devan noted it at the time as a kind man's name.
facts.why: needed because Devan must connect Ittan to the marriage in the chapter's chain of inference.

facts.fact: Ittan's genial letter said he would come himself this season to seal the pass and see how the match has prospered; Devan read it aloud to Neela one night.
facts.why: needed because the outline has Neela say Ittan is coming to them; this is the setup (ch 17 letter about the monsoon sealing).

facts.fact: The pass closes in eight days from the morning of chapter 23 (the sealing day); the new moon falls before it.
facts.why: outline requires 'eight days'; flagged because earlier chapters' night counts to the pass closing may differ and should be reconciled.

facts.fact: Border charter custom: on sealing day every cart leaving through the padippura is searched before it goes, with no exception written for the Keeper.
facts.why: needed to establish the border-law plan; the outline names the rule but not its form.

facts.fact: Neela tells Devan the slip came from a guild-sister who tore it off a carrier's satchel, and says she will not say more; Devan does not ask.
facts.why: needed to account for the slip without exposing Ammu.
